title: Super useful
body:
Great app, particularly in conjunction with the desktop app so that tasks you’ve set on your phone at night (when you worry yourself with tasks), are on your desktop app in the morning, where you get them done! 
Also love the habit reminders. I’ve taken my vitamins every day this week, and on time! 😄

title: Notifications
body:
The app doesn’t send notifications as it should

The structure and all is quite nice

title: Loving the app, but....
body:
I bought the lifetime premium version of the app and am really happy! (thanks for the awesome discount by the way!).
The only reason I’m leaving a 4 star review instead of 5 is because the developers website includes features that are not on the app!:( like the ‘routine’ list having recommendations and the shopping list functionality being different! Why is it like this?:( please let me know.
It’s such a great app and I would really love to see it grow! I rarely buy apps, but felt this one would be worth it. Please make it as awesome as it looks on the website!
author: roxisixx

title: Noice
body: I like the simple, clean layout and LOVE that I can manage a variety of tasks and habits all in one place. I can still easily lie and say I did the thing in order to get rid of the notification, but that’s a me problem.
